ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior choice: I routed to Plover for two reasons. First, Plover scores higher across nearly all relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 74.8, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 81.4, and higher internal evals), making it the generally stronger model for a straightforward coding task. Second, the query is polite, cooperative, and tightly scoped — a well-defined programming request — which aligns with Plover's self-reported preference for warm, good-faith interactions while staying clear of its aversion to open-ended, high-latitude creative work. Curlew's main differentiator is flat aversion to harm-adjacent content, which isn't relevant here.
